source: CRON 20261014: H1 2026 column added from Merafe Resources Limited unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (issuer's results booklet, meraferesources.co.za/results/interims-2026/pdf/booklet.pdf, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 6 of the booklet), R'000 stored as absolute rand: Revenue 3,433,123; foreign exchange loss 10,473; operating and other expenses 2,648,987; EBITDA 773,663; depreciation and amortisation 90,580; impairments 15,931; income from equity accounted investment 6,092; results from operating activities 673,244; finance income 28,884; finance expense 933; profit before taxation 701,195; taxation 189,290; total comprehensive income for the period 511,905. Mapping, chosen so the panel's arithmetic ties: Cost of Sales is operating and other expenses plus the foreign exchange loss, which reproduces the issuer's printed EBITDA as gross profit (3,433,123 less 2,659,460 equals 773,663); Operating Expenses is depreciation and amortisation plus impairments less income from equity accounted investment, which reproduces the printed results from operating activities (773,663 less 100,419 equals 673,244); Net Finance Costs is the net finance income (28,884 less 933 equals 27,951) stored negative because it is income, so operating profit less net finance costs equals the printed profit before taxation. Gates tie: 701,195 less 189,290 equals 511,905. EPS is the printed basic earnings per share of 20.5 cents, stored in rand as 0.205 (net profit 511,905,000 divided by 2,499,126,870 shares equals 0.205). Gross, operating and net margin are computed from this column. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty for H1 2026 because no H1 2026 balance sheet inputs were read in this pass. | Yahoo Finance
